digest.component_or_area: optional dependency plumbing and runtime guard
propositions: S3 ticket-store backend requires git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 as an optional dependency that must be declared in pyproject.toml and probed at runtime without importing the package itself

require_s3_helper() must validate that both the git-remote-s3 console script exists on PATH and the installed distribution version is at least 0.3.2, using only stdlib for version parsing and comparison
Missing or insufficient git-remote-s3 must raise OptionalDependencyError with an actionable install hint containing the exact string 'pip install nava-rebar[s3]'
Version comparison must fail closed on unparseable version strings and handle post-release/suffixed versions by parsing only the leading numeric triplet
The s3 entry must be added to EXTRAS in _optional.py following the existing optional-extra pattern, and guard_import must work with extra='s3'
